2: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm by Asaph. A song. In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.
3: His tabernacle is also in Salem; His dwelling place in Zion.
4: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.
5: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.
6: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.
7: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a deep sleep.
8: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?
9: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,
10: when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.
11: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.
12: Make vows to the Lord your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.
13: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.
